purpose: Illustrative terrain artwork; not historical or georeferenced evidence

prompts.meadow: Create one square seamless game terrain texture for an 1862 Shenandoah Valley hex wargame: directly overhead orthographic farmland meadow, finely detailed muted olive and sage grass, dry straw patches, tiny subtle earth variation. Entire image filled edge to edge. Uniform broad-scale surface, no roads rivers fences buildings objects text grid hex shapes borders shadows or perspective. Photorealistic hand-painted terrain texture style, natural and restrained, clear at small size. Opposite edges should tile seamlessly.
prompts.woodland: Create one square seamless game terrain texture for an 1862 Shenandoah Valley hex wargame: directly overhead orthographic deciduous woodland in early spring, dense fine-scale oak and mixed tree crowns with olive and dark sage foliage, glimpses of warm soil. Entire image filled edge to edge, individual trees small enough to show a woodland area. No roads rivers buildings text grid hex shapes borders perspective or isolated giant trees. Detailed realistic hand-painted terrain texture, subdued natural colors and gentle ambient light. Opposite edges should tile seamlessly.
prompts.ridge: Create one square game terrain texture for an 1862 Shenandoah Valley hex wargame: directly overhead orthographic Appalachian wooded ridge, subtle folded limestone ridgeline running diagonally across muted olive sage woodland and straw grass, readable natural relief with very gentle northwest illumination, small rock outcrops. All four edges covered in same low-contrast meadow and woodland ground texture to blend with neighboring terrain. No roads rivers buildings snow text grid hex outline borders perspective or vertical cliffs. Refined realistic hand-painted cartographic game terrain, no exaggerated mountain symbols.
prompts.village: Create one square game terrain texture for an 1862 Shenandoah Valley hex wargame: directly overhead orthographic small rural Virginia village, handful of tiny historically plausible white clapboard and brick houses, gray and brown pitched roofs, barns and garden plots loosely centered among muted olive sage meadows. Tiny buildings appropriately scaled to a 400m ground area. Edge areas all meadow, no road or river crossing image boundary. No modern objects vehicles power lines pavement text grid hex outline borders or perspective. Refined realistic hand-painted cartographic terrain, subtle ambient shadows, detailed but readable at small sizes.
prompts.channel: Square seamless directly overhead orthographic shallow river water surface texture for an 1862 Shenandoah Valley wargame. Entire frame is muted slate blue and green-gray clear freshwater, subtle small ripples and hints of smooth riverbed stones under water, quiet natural inland river. No banks, shoreline, roads, bridges, boats, buildings, text, grid, border, hex shapes, horizon or perspective. Refined realistic hand-painted terrain texture. Low contrast, restrained detail. Opposite edges tile seamlessly.
prompts.continuous_landscape: Create a continuous overhead terrain master image for a historical Shenandoah Valley 1862 strategy wargame. Absolutely straight-down orthographic aerial plan view, no horizon, no isometric building sides. A SINGLE coherent landscape, no tiles, no panels, no grid or text. Natural muted early-spring olive/sage and straw meadow covers the ENTIRE landscape. A broad irregular deciduous woodland occupies the left third and lower-left, transitioning through scattered small trees and scrub into open meadow along a soft natural boundary. A small historically plausible Virginia hamlet of six tiny clapboard/brick houses, barns and gardens sits just right of center along one narrow dirt lane, with scattered orchard trees. Houses must be small relative to the whole landscape (each roof about 1-2 percent of image width), so settlement occupies less than 15 percent of total area. One dirt lane curves naturally across the meadow from lower center past the hamlet toward upper right. Woodland crowns should be small (each 0.5-1 percent image width), many varied crowns, no copied obvious motifs. Shared ground palette and uniform gentle ambient light throughout. Readable realistic hand-painted cartographic terrain with fine detail. No military figures or modern objects. No hexagons, borders, labels, shaded polygons, brown hex-shaped fields or tile seams. This image will be cut across arbitrary hex boundaries, so the forest and lane must remain genuinely continuous.
